text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Bestview Drive, between Harrington Crescent and Kentland Crescent. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Bestview Drive.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (four speed humps) on Bestview Drive, between Harrington Crescent and Kentland Crescent, generally as shown in Attachment 2, Drawing Number TC-780, dated June 2026, to the report (June 18, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
